metadata.description: 在 DeepSeek Harness 的每条回复下面加一行：本次问答花了多少钱 + 账户余额（充值/礼金分开列，没有礼金就只显示充值余额）。鼠标悬停时显示饼图。按该轮 token 用量乘官方峰谷单价计算，内置节假日表；算不出价就写明原因，不静默出错。插件自身不联网（余额由 dsh 宿主查询）、不落盘、无依赖。

# dsh-cost-receipt
English | 中文
A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin that adds one line under every reply telling you what that exchange
cost, plus the account balance. Hover for a pie chart of the cost breakdown, drawn by cost share.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## What it does
- **Priced per exchange**: one line under every reply, showing what the exchange you just had cost.
Historical turns carry their own numbers too, priced at the rate of their own time window, so openin

g an old session still computes.
- **The balance is two numbers**: `account balance` counts top-up f
unds only, `bonus balance` gets its own line, and only their sum is the wallet total. The second lin
e disappears when there is no bonus. Balances appear only on the newest turn of a conversation, beca

use showing historical balances would be meaningless.
- **Hover for the breakdown**: the current exc
hange and the whole conversation are drawn as **two rings side by side, by cost share, not by token
share**. Cached tokens are usually ~99% of the token count but under 40% of the cost; a token-based

chart collapses into an invisible sliver.
- **When a price cannot be computed it says why**, never s
ilently: the badge reads `unpriced model xxx`, `mixed models (a + b)`, `usage without a model`. Appl

ying another model's unit price would be off by several times and invisible.
- **The timestamp on th
e badge means "unchanged", not "just read"**: the host caches account queries, so that `HH:MM:SS` is
**when the balance last changed** — a still timestamp means the number has not moved. Hovering also
shows the last query time, so comparing the two tells you whether the reading is stale or the balan
ce genuinely did not change.

## Privacy and network
- **The plugin makes no network calls of its own**: `client.js` / `index.js` contain no `fetch`, `XM

LHttpRequest` or WebSocket calls — you can check line by line.
- **The balance is read through the h
ost**: the plugin asks the dsh host for `account/getBalance` (the same path as your account settings
page), which means **one account query every 30 seconds, dropping to every 3 minutes while the page
is hidden**. That is its only outward-facing action, and it goes through dsh's own account feature;

the account token never leaves the host.
- **No storage**: it writes no files and uses no localStor

age.
- **No credential access**: it does not read your API key or any configuration file.
- The only
local data it reads is the current session's token usage — the same data behind dsh's own "turn usa
a it reads is the current session's token usage — the same data behind dsh's own "turn usage" panel.
> `tools/fetch-holidays.mjs` in the repository is a **maintenance script** that refreshes the built-
in holiday table. It needs the network (a third-party holiday API by default, or the URL of the Stat
e Council notice for cross-checking), is run manually **once a year** by the maintainer, and **is no
t shipped in the npm package** (the `files` whitelist only carries what the plugin needs at runtime)
shipped in the npm package** (the `files` whitelist only carries what the plugin needs at runtime).
## Pricing scope and limits
| Item | Basis |

| One exchange | one user message → the final reply |
| Calculation | cached input / uncached input
/ cache write / output are priced separately. Cache write is billed as uncached input (there is no s

eparate cache-write price) |
| Unit prices | per million tokens, **per currency and per model**: CNY

and USD each have their own official list, priced independently — nothing is converted |
| Time win
dow | peak = Beijing time Monday–Friday 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00, **excluding statutory holidays*

*; everything else is off-peak. Evaluation is independent of your system time zone |
| Holidays | th
e State Council's 2026 schedule is built in (19 days). Years outside the table fall back to "no corr

ection" — it does not give a wrong answer, it just stops correcting |
| Currency | **CNY and USD acc
ounts.** The wallet's currency picks the price list and amounts are shown in that currency; a mixed

or any other currency shows no amounts at all, just a notice that only CNY and USD are supported |
|
Search and fetch | **outside the table above.** `web_search` retrieves on the server side (a separa
te model request), and those tokens never reach this session's usage; the Search/Fetch APIs also bil
l per request (¥0.005 / $0.00075 each from 2026-11-01). Text returned by `web_fetch` **is** included
per request (¥0.005 / $0.00075 each from 2026-11-01). Text returned by `web_fetch` **is** included |
Known margins:
- **Turns that cross a peak/off-peak boundary** are priced entirely by their end time, worst case ab

out 50% off (a 5-minute turn straddling a boundary is roughly a 1.4% case).
[该节后续省略]
## Compatibility
- Requires **dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 or newer**: the plugin depends on the host's turn-tail data and account
Remote. Those two interfaces were checked on **0.2.1-rc.2 and 0.2.1-rc.3**; if the badge disappears

after a dsh upgrade, this is the first thing to suspect.
- Web and desktop, Windows and macOS (a pur

e client plugin: it touches no filesystem and has no platform branches).
- Accounts in any currency
other than CNY or USD show no amounts (see above).
